decisions.reason: This core navigation and observation camera has its own page and sits close to the established offer, so the firm has visible, sunk commitment and no reason to write it off.
The modular camera line has proven flight heritage with the ESA HERA launch, and it is publicly showcased, so dropping it would contradict a visible success.
The space situational awareness suite fits the announced strategic direction and has its own page, and its long space sales cycles let slow results be read as temporary.
The miniaturized LiDAR is only mentioned and has less visible commitment, but it matches the stated push toward compact sensors and docking, so the firm persists.
The radiation-hard camera line launched recently with its own page, so heavy recent investment and public commitment make keeping it clearly favored.
The asteroid camera is tied to the HERA mission heritage and launched only in 2024, so its results are too early to judge and it stays on the market.
